occurrences.text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
